description: Use when the customer names the countries of a trip instead of a size: returns which countries are included (countries that are not included come back in not_covered), a suggested data size from the days (up to 90) and usage (light ≈ 0.5 GB/day, normal ≈ 1.5, heavy ≈ 4; rounded up to the next size) and server quotes for that size and one size down and up, each with its buy_url. Same prices as quote_esim.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. en-gb, de-de (sets currency and link locale). Defaults from language.

budget.description: Optional budget in the quoted currency; options above it are marked.

countries.description: The countries of the trip, names in any language or ISO-2 codes, e.g. ["France", "Italy", "Spain"]. Map cities to their countries first.

days.description: Optional: days the customer will use mobile data (one eSIM is valid 90 days). Without days the size follows the usage alone (light 5 / normal 10 / heavy 20 GB).

gb_per_day.description: Optional: the customer's own estimate in GB per day (wins over usage).

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, it. Localizes country names and sets the language/currency of links and prices.

usage.description: light ≈ 0.5 GB/day (messaging, maps, mail), normal ≈ 1.5 GB/day (default; social media, music, some video), heavy ≈ 4 GB/day (video streaming, video calls, hotspot for a laptop).

name: recommend_config
title: Recommend for a trip
